analysis.reason: RSI 27.0으로 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있으며, 5일 전 26.8에서 소폭 상승에 그쳐 탈출이 지연되고 있다. ADX 49.1로 추세 강도는 높으나 +DI 11.8 대비 -DI 36.1이 우세하여 하락 압력이 강하다. 5일 저가보다 높은 저가를 형성했으나 5일 고가는 20일 고가보다 낮아 추세 전환 신뢰도가 낮다. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 27.0, still in oversold territory, with only a slight increase from 26.8 five days ago, delaying an oversold exit. ADX at 49.1 indicates a strong trend, but -DI at 36.1 is dominant over +DI at 11.8, showing downward pressure. While a higher low has formed compared to the 5-day low, the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, reducing trend reversal confidence. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($59,920.23) vs SMA5 ($60,350.38)/SMA20 ($65,148.17)/SMA50 ($74,243.42): below short-term, below mid-term, below long-term, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($77,385.85)/SMA200 ($71,811.2): maintaining strong weakness below long-term trends.
· 52-week position (11.2%) + current price level slightly above 52-week low ($55,149.57).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (26.8→27.0) + sustained oversold condition + delayed exit.
· MACD histogram trajectory (30.7457→30.7457) + holding steady + weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $54,154.32, Middle $65,148.17) + band width at 33.75% indicating expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($59,108.92) + basis (close to current price, above Pivot S1 ($51,347.64)).
· Swing resistance ($65,401.69) + potential to reclaim middle band (SMA20) upon breakout.
· 5-day high ($64,478.36) < 20-day high ($76,096.69) → Lower High pattern weakening, 5-day low ($57,241.84) > 20-day low ($55,149.57) → Higher Low pattern signaling recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + specifying buy conditions on rebound from 5-day low and strengthened buy on breakout of 5-day high.
